_help: Training Room bridge settings. Restart the bridge after editing. port: HTTPS port for the headset/phone on your network; httpPort: plain HTTP on this laptop only (also for adb reverse); roomKey: code other devices need (delete it to get a new one); provider: "ollama" or "openai" (LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server at openaiUrl); model: "" picks an installed model automatically (names with "coder", then "qwen"); think: false turns hidden reasoning off for faster answers, true on, null leaves the model default; sttKind: "whisper.cpp" (whisper-server at sttUrl), "openai" (an /v1/audio/transcriptions URL) or "none"; sttPrompt: optional words that help Whisper spell part names; partsDirs: extra folders with parts (blueprint .json, .glb/.gltf, .js); allowOrigins: web pages allowed to call this bridge from another site. This file is an example: the bridge creates config.json in its data folder on first run (Windows: %APPDATA%\dot-training-room, elsewhere ~/.config/dot-training-room).
